title: Realtime Puzzle Gumball Drag
description:
Puzzle 3D gumball dragging is insanely slow and buggy. It should realtime-update during drag and keep working when used several times.

Implemented scratch-session transformBegin/transformEnd in puzzle plugin, absolute-from-start gumball deltas + rAF coalesce + serialized dispatch in World3dHost, and SceneGumball pivot freeze while dragging. Closing after verification.
